what.text: This page follows people displaced inside the State of Palestine by conflict and violence, as estimated by IDMC.
At the end of 2025, IDMC estimated 2035131 people living in internal displacement there.
The UNHCR figures on this page cover refugees and asylum seekers from the State of Palestine, not people displaced inside it.

why.text: The sources on this page don't record the causes of this displacement: there are no dated events or armed conflicts for the State of Palestine in them.
Floods and storms are the disasters recorded for the State of Palestine in IDMC's data.

when.text: IDMC's figure rose from 160000 in 2009 to 2035131 in 2025.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2023 to 2025, after a big change between 2022 and 2023.
IDMC recorded the most new displacements from conflict in 2023.

how.text: IDMC's new displacements count movements, not people: one person forced to move several times in a year is counted each time.
Refugees from the State of Palestine counted by UNHCR live mainly in Greece and Belgium.
The sources don't say where inside the State of Palestine people moved to.
